# Momentum
> Fitness consistency for adults 40 and over. A one-minute daily readiness check-in (sleep, energy, recovery, soreness, pain, desire to train) returns one of four plans: full workout, reduced workout, mobility and recovery, or rest day. Streaks have a 48-hour repair window for a single missed day. Momentum does not write workouts and is not medical advice. Free: up to 3 habits, the daily check-in, streak repair, 7 days of history. Premium: $7.99 per month or $69.99 per year, adding unlimited habits, unlimited history, an AI Coach chat, a Weekly Insights report and data export. https://momentumfit.app
